article.title: The Geographic Spread of COVID-19 Correlates with Structure of Social Networks as Measured by Facebook
article.excerpt: There is a new NBER working paper (by economists) on Covid-19: We use anonymized and aggregated data from Facebook to show that areas with stronger social ties to two early COVID-19 “hotspots” (Westchester County, NY, in the U.S. and Lodi province in Italy) generally have more confirmed COVID-19 cases as of March 30, 2020.
